relations: Ripples traveling across the water surface distort the tree's reflection branch by branch, while the actual silhouette remains fixed.
A bright streak appearing on the right side of the water reflection lingers briefly and then fades away.
A soft glint emerging on the left side of the water shortly after holds briefly and dissolves.
The sky and horizon stay static as the water maintains its quiet, rippling character.
caption: The video captures a single leafless tree silhouetted at the center of a low, dark horizon beneath a twilight sky that fades from deep blue to a pale glow and is scattered with faint stars. A still body of water fills the lower half of the frame and mirrors the tree, its reflection wobbling and distorting branch by branch as gentle ripples travel across the surface throughout the excerpt. The tree, sky, and horizon stay fixed while only the reflected image shifts. A faint bright streak surfaces on the water right of the reflection, lingers, then fades. A separate soft glint appears on the left side of the water shortly afterward, holds briefly, and dissolves. These disturbances pass over the surface without altering the silhouette above. The water keeps its quiet, rippling character from the first frame to the last.
